caption: The video captures a close-up view of a white plate holding four large chocolate chip cookies, each decorated with colorful sprinkles around the edges. Several long, thin birthday candles in blue, yellow, pink, and orange are inserted into the cookies, their flames flickering brightly. In the background, a man wearing a white t-shirt sits at a wooden dining table facing away from the camera, while two young boys are seated across from him. The scene is set in a home interior with natural light streaming through windows behind the family. As the clip progresses, the camera slowly pans to the right, shifting the perspective on the cookie arrangement. This movement reveals a third child, a girl with blonde hair, who becomes visible sitting next to the boys at the table. The group appears engaged and happy, smiling towards the person holding the dessert.
